title: Entra ID Basics
description: Learn how Azure Entra ID manages users, groups, and enterprise applications in the cloud.

data.text: **Entra ID** (formerly Azure Active Directory) is Microsoft's cloud-based identity and access management service. Every Microsoft 365, Azure, and many third-party app subscription relies on it to verify who you are and what you're allowed to do.

data.title: Building blocks of Entra ID
items: **Tenant** — A dedicated instance of Entra ID for your organization. Every Azure subscription is linked to exactly one tenant.
**User** — An identity (person or service) that can sign in. Users have an email, display name, and assigned roles.
**Group** — A collection of users. Assign permissions to a group once instead of to each person individually.
**Enterprise Application** — An instance of a service (like Salesforce or your own SaaS app) that trusts Entra ID for sign-in.
**Service Principal** — The local representation of an enterprise app in your tenant. It defines what the app can do in Azure.

terms.definition: A dedicated instance of Entra ID for an organization, isolated from every other tenant.
The Azure identity for an app or service, used for non-interactive sign-in and automation.
A unified REST API that provides access to Entra ID and other Microsoft cloud services.

data.text: Once you have an access token, you can call the Microsoft Graph API to manage users, groups, and apps. The most common endpoint is `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/`.

data.title: List users in your tenant
data.content: Send a GET request to the users endpoint. Replace the token with your own from Azure AD.
data.code:
curl -X GET \
  https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOi...' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Entra ID is the identity layer for every Microsoft cloud service
Tenants are isolated — your organization's directory is separate from others
Groups simplify permission management by avoiding per-user assignments
Microsoft Graph is the programmatic gateway to Entra ID resources
data.takeaway: Entra ID is the foundation of Azure security. Everything else — roles, policies, access — builds on top of it.
